question: Where did the IBA Women's World Boxing Championships 2023 take place in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The IBA Women's World Boxing Championships 2023 took place in **New Delhi, India**.
 
• The event was held from **15th March to 26th March 2023**.
 
• It was organized by the **International Boxing Association (IBA)** in collaboration with the **Boxing Federation of India (BFI)**.
 
• India hosted the championships for the third time, having previously hosted it in **2006 and 2018**.
 
• The event witnessed the participation of **over 300 boxers from 65 countries**, competing across multiple weight categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Boxing Association (IBA)**:

 
 
• The IBA is the global governing body for amateur boxing.
 
• It was founded in **1946** and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• The IBA organizes world championships for both men and women in boxing.
 
 
 
• **Boxing Federation of India (BFI)**:
 
 
• The BFI is the national governing body for boxing in India.
 
• It was established in **2016** and is responsible for promoting and developing boxing in the country.
 
• BFI played a key role in hosting the 2023 IBA Women's World Boxing Championships.
 
 
 
• **Women's World Boxing Championships**:
 
 
• It is a prestigious tournament that has been held since **2001**.
 
• The event is conducted every two years and features elite female boxers from around the world.
 
• It serves as a platform to showcase talent and promote women's participation in boxing.
 
 
 
• **India's Achievements in Boxing**:
 
 
• India has produced notable boxers like **Mary Kom**, who is a six-time world champion.
 
• Mary Kom won gold medals in the Women's World Boxing Championships held in **2002, 2005, 2006, 2008, 2010, and 2018**.
 
• India continues to be a strong contender in international boxing events.
